title: Milestone 1: the shared game interface
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: Every game's rules now have a reward hook, 0.0 by default and never stored in replays, and an opt-in fixed-size number view for training tools. A match keeps its action history in one buffer, which removes two allocations per tick. Every pinned hash, parity fixture and replay file is unchanged, and the match runner is about 18% faster. The customizable agents now have a name: Nyborgs.
next: Milestone 2, the tank refit, with Blitzwing.
